name: HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS
description:
HZ_GEOGRPHY_IDENTIFIERS stores multiple identifiers used to describe the same geography.  The values stored in this field may come from different geography data providers or entered by the user. Identifiers include Names (such as Alternate Names or Vanity Names) and Codes (for example ISO codes for countries or UN/LOCODES for locations). 
For Example: This table would store the vanity name of a section of Redwood City as Redwood Shores.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIER_ID
columns.description: Unique id for geography identifier.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for this geography (Foreign Key to HZ_GEOGRAPHIES.GEOGRAPHY_ID)

columns.name: IMPORT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Import batch ID of the geography identifier record. This column indicates the batch id of the latest import batch which created/updated this geography identifier record

columns.name: GEO_DATA_PROVIDER
columns.description: Name of the data source provider

columns.name: IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE
columns.description: Specifies the type of a code or a name. Value is from lookup of type HZ_GEO_IDENTIFIER_SUBTYPE. Sample values are FIPS_CODE, GEO_CODE, ISO_COUNTRY_CODE, STANDARD_NAME, etc.

columns.name: IDENTIFIER_VALUE
columns.description: Stores the geography identifier value of the geography record for the specified identifier type

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: IDENTIFIER_TYPE
columns.description: Specifies whether the value in identifier_value is a code or a name. Value is from lookup of type HZ_GEO_IDENTIFIER_TYPE. Sample values are CODE and NAME.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this name or code is the default for this geography. Y for primary and N for non-primary records.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_CODE
columns.description: Stores the language in which identifier_value is stored

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_USE
columns.description: Use of geography data

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Type of geography data

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Code of the Country to which the Geography belongs.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.description: Source application module that created this record.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
